story.text: Act II, and the reason the gate exists: two authorities pooling threat intelligence with nothing worth stealing in transit.

Only a flying carrier may assemble a bundle, and bundles are minimised BY CONSTRUCTION: 17 incidents become "≥10", timestamps become a quarter, artifact lists become one digest. Every bundle states on its face: against whom it protects, for how long, what it may lawfully be combined with.

The receiving authority verifies offline from the bytes plus ONE public lookup — the issuer's revocation status list. So when the issuer revokes, the receiver's next check refuses the stale bundle: the pool heals itself. See [[Revocation]].
